settings.consentText: I understand that Aarogya Drishti provides an AI-assisted preliminary oral health screening for educational awareness and clinical triage only. This screening does not constitute a medical diagnosis, does not confirm or rule out oral cancer, and does not replace an in-person clinical examination or biopsy by a qualified healthcare professional. I consent to the secure storage and processing of my questionnaire responses and uploaded oral photographs by the platform and any doctor I choose to consult.
